source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Causativization as lexicon-internal operation in Sakha
notes: Various pieces of evidence point to the lexical status of causatives in Sakha. First of all, predicates whose external arguments are not specified as [+c] and which therefore do not qualify according to (45a) cannot be causativized. This explains the ungrammaticality of (48b) with subject experiencer predicates causativized.
